preconditions.description: The number of nodes n must be greater than k, and both must be within the range of 2 to 1000.

postconditions.description: The first line of output must be the minimum number of colors c needed.
The second line of output must contain exactly (n(n-1))/2 integers representing the edge colors.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(color) <= c for color in stdout.split()[1:])
postconditions.description: All edge colors must be integers ranging from 1 to c.
